settings.text:
• About an order: your order number and the email you used.
  • About a jar: the batch number printed on the jar, and a photo if something looks wrong.
  • Which amount to give: your dog’s weight, age and breed.
  • About your subscription: you can skip, pause or cancel online yourself in your account.
